title: [review] project-LICHEN-n8c6: OSCORE spec-compliance test vectors removed
description: In rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs, the test_request_protection_vectors and test_response_protection_vectors functions were deleted instead of being fixed. These tests validated OSCORE protect_request and protect_response operations against canonical RFC 8613 test vectors from test/vectors/oscore.json. Deleting them removes critical spec-compliance coverage. The compilation issues could have been resolved by removing the duplicate context_at() function and adding None for the id_context parameter in test_response_protection_vectors. Instead the tests were removed entirely.
